import json, re
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('testdata/aws/sns/encryption_event_source_cache.json')
s=json.loads(p.read_text())
assert s.get('finished_ms') and not s.get('failure'),s.get('failure')
R=s['owned_resources']; obs={o['label']:o for o in s['observations']}; clean={o['label']:o for o in s['cleanup']}
findings=[]
for phase,published in s['events'].items():
    case=published['case']; topic=R['topics']['fresh' if case=='fresh' else 'shared']; rule=R['rules'][case]['arn']
    receipts=[r for r in s['receipts'] if r['phase']==phase and r['correlated']]
    rows=[]
    for r in receipts:
        assert r['decoded_event']['id']==published['event_id']
        assert r['decoded_event']['detail']==published['detail']
        if r['queue']=='dlq':
            assert r['decoded_message_attributes']['RULE_ARN']==rule
            assert r['decoded_message_attributes']['TARGET_ARN']==topic
        request_ids=re.findall(r'Request ID: ([0-9a-f-]+)',r['decoded_message_attributes'].get('ERROR_MESSAGE',''))
        correlated_events=[x['event'] for x in s['cloudtrail']['events'] if x['event'].get('requestID') in request_ids]
        rows.append({'queue':r['queue'],'sqs_message_id':r['message']['MessageId'],'receipt_observed_ms':r['observed_ms'],'error_code':r['decoded_message_attributes'].get('ERROR_CODE'),'error_message':r['decoded_message_attributes'].get('ERROR_MESSAGE'),'correlated_kms_request_ids':request_ids,'cloudtrail_event_ids':[e['eventID'] for e in correlated_events]})
    findings.append({'phase':phase,'case':case,'event_id':published['event_id'],'source_rule_arn':rule,'topic_arn':topic,'outcome':'collector' if any(r['queue']=='collector' for r in receipts) else 'dlq' if receipts else 'bounded_missing','evidence':rows})
by_phase={f['phase']:f for f in findings}
for phase in ['A-warm','A-disabled-before','A-disabled-after','B-restored','B-restored-renewal']: assert by_phase[phase]['outcome']=='collector',(phase,by_phase[phase])
for phase in ['fresh-disabled','B-disabled-first']:
    assert by_phase[phase]['outcome']=='dlq',by_phase[phase]
    assert 'KMSDisabled' in by_phase[phase]['evidence'][0]['error_message']
